text:
nina: FYI planning a staggered canary tonight for engine runtime: ABI bump + quant-matmul v3. quiet window 01:30-04:30 UTC. want cascade plan, pin TTL, rollback votes, and a one-line release-note.

deploy-bot: Preflight: artifacts signed, smoke image built, integ tests pass. to start: `deploy-bot set-slice`.
jamal: Suggest cascade: eu -> us-east -> us-west. start 0.5% in eu, warmstart 5m, monitor 15m then 2% -> 5% if stable. Keep total <5% until midnight UTC.
sre-ops: Agree. Pin TTL 12h (so we don't lose telemetry before debug). prefer drain order: eu, us-east, us-west. No other infra changes during window.
maya: Release-note draft: "Runtime: ABI bump + optimized quant matmul kernels (v3). Expect lower median latency for short/medium sequences; canary gated; automatic fallback to v2 on anomalies." PR: https://git.internal/docs/engine/release-notes/pull/88
ryan: Metrics to watch: p95/p99, kv-cache hit ratio, mem growth per-host, allocation spike, and error-rate. Alert thresholds: p99 +12% for 10m OR error-rate +0.15% sustained 10m -> rollback.
nina: Added binary note: v3 has a new packing layout, binary +6MB. might cause slightly longer cold-starts; include in notes.
jamal: Also watch long-seq perf—locally v3 sometimes regresses p99 on seq>4096 by ~8%. keep a long-seq slice in canary traffic if possible.
deploy-bot: Action queued: `pin engine:quant-matmul:v3 --ttl=12h --reason="cascade-canary+abi"`.
```
# planned canary
# step 1: eu 0.5% warmstart 5m -> observe 15m
# step 2: eu 2% -> observe 30m
# step 3: us-east 1% -> observe 20m
# step 4: us-west 1% -> hold
deploy-bot set-slice --service engine --from v2 --to v3 --slice 0.005 --warmstart 5m --meta "cascade:eu-first"
```

sre-ops: We'll run the regional drains at 01:35-01:45 (eu), 02:10-02:25 (us-east), 02:45-03:00 (us-west). Ops oncall will be standing by.
ryan: I'll wire dashboards and add temporary alerting for the thresholds. tagging @devex to add note link to console.
nina: I will hit the canary button at 6521113600 unless objections. If any alert fires, call for a rollback vote in this thread.
jamal: +1 from me.
sre-ops: +1 from ops.
maya: I'll merge release-note PR once canary starts and update the doc with the observed perf.

deploy-bot: Action: `pin engine:quant-matmul:v3 --ttl=12h --reason="cascade-canary+abi"` applied by @nina at 6521113600.

ryan: After canary start i'll post a short periodic status every 15m (p95/p99, cache-hit, mem-delta).
nina: Thanks all. Rollback command (if we need it):
```
# immediate rollback to v2 and remove pin
deploy-bot set-slice --service engine --from v3 --to v2 --slice 1.0 --force
deploy-bot unpin engine:quant-matmul:v3
```

nina: Posting final canary start now. please report any anomalies here. :rocket:
